risks.proof: A close-up photo of both discs/plates (front and back) with light reflecting off the surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed/possibly not working (worst case for used discs).

risks.risk: May not boot / may have installation or read errors.

risks.if_unproven: Price as not working until tested.

risks.risk: Case may be damaged or missing inserts (not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the back cover and inside inserts (manual/cover inserts) and any damage to the case.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of both discs/plates (front + back) showing scratches clearly.
A video of the game booting on a PS4 and reaching the main menu.
Photo of the disc label/region code and the back cover (edition details).
Photos of the case back and inside inserts/manual (if any).
response.reason: The photo confirms the PS4 game title on the case, but it does not prove the discs are present/clean or that it works. Without a boot/test or disc close-ups, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
